text:
Ben: alarms for trace_export_errors in us-west-1 are firing hard. seeing large gaps in trace timelines in prod. :rotating_light:
ops-bot: Pager duty triggered (P2) \u2014 trace export failure rate > 35% over 5m in us-west-1. Paging oncall.
Karla: oncall taking. any immediate customer-facing outages?
Ben: collector accepts spans but exporter is getting 401s then 429s, then 503s from the Honeycomb ingest; queues growing ~30k spans across replicas. some customers DM'd support about missing traces.
Aly: looking at shipper logs now:
```
2026-04-02T15:02:11Z exporter honeycomb.go:210 ExportBatch failed status=401 body="Unauthorized: token expired"
2026-04-02T15:02:17Z exporter honeycomb.go:215 Token refresh attempt failed: 429 Too Many Requests
2026-04-02T15:02:34Z exporter honeycomb.go:220 ExportBatch failed status=503 body="upstream service unavailable"
```
Karla: 401 then 429 suggests our token provider (Auth0) rate-limiting refreshes or having its own degraded window. let's triage: immediate mitigations: 1) flip exporters to buffer-only to stop retry storm, 2) set exporter retries to 0 to avoid amplification, 3) contact Honeycomb and Auth0 and create incident id RI-2026-201987.
Ben: applying buffer-only and reducing retries. command:
```bash
kubectl -n telemetry set env deployment/trace-shipper EXPORT_MODE=buffer-only EXPORT_RETRIES=0 BUFFER_RETENTION_HOURS=72
kubectl -n telemetry rollout restart deployment/trace-shipper
```
deploy-bot: deploy started: trace-shipper rollout/trace-shipper (rev: a1d5f)  triggered by Ben 
Ben: change in, watching queues.
Aly: backlog growth halted within 30s, retries dropped from ~70% -> 8%. disk buffers increased but within threshold (us-west nodes at 24%).
Karla: pinging Honeycomb and Auth0. include sample request ids, token refresh logs, and our incident tag.
Ben: Honeycomb support: "we see elevated 503s in us-west-1; our ingest gateway shows upstream 429s from your token issuer. Investigating. Ticket HB-31022."
Auth0-support: (automated) "We are experiencing an elevated token refresh throttling event in us-west-1 due to a backend cache issue. Mitigation in progress; next update in 10m."
Aly: note: our exporter uses an in-process token cache with per-instance refresh; when many pods try to refresh at once we get thundering herd. that's why retries spike CPU. we should have a shared cache or backoff.
Karla: agreed. short-term: keep exporters buffered. mid-term: INFRA-7801 for shared token caching + client-side jittered refresh.
Ben: craft a status message: short blurb for status.redwood.ai and support.
Karla: draft: "We're investigating an issue impacting trace export to an observability provider in us-west-1. Traces are accepted by our collectors but may be delayed or missing in vendor dashboards. We're buffering incoming telemetry and working with the vendor and our token provider. We'll post updates." will post after Ops review.
ops-bot: Status page updated by Karla  https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/RI-2026-201987
Auth0-support: update: mitigation deployed; token refresh rate limiting lifted as of 15:18Z. We're continuing to monitor. Ticket: AUTH-9876.
Honeycomb-support: update: our ingest 5xxs are decreasing, we see fewer auth failures after Auth0 mitigation. We'll continue monitoring and advise when exports are stable.
Aly: propose controlled canary: enable live exports for 5% of replicas with export retries still at 0, monitor success and duplicate rates. use k8s label `auth-canary=true`.
Ben: go for it. apply canary env to a subset and watch for 5xxs or token refresh errors.
Ben: canary patch command:
```bash
# label two pods as canary and set live mode for them
kubectl -n telemetry label pod trace-shipper-rc-canary app=trace-shipper auth-canary=true
kubectl -n telemetry set env deployment/trace-shipper EXPORT_MODE=live --selector=auth-canary=true
```
deploy-bot: canary applied: trace-shipper/canary (replicas:2)
Aly: canary metrics: exports success 99.6% for canary; no 401/429 observed in last 3m. backlog draining slowly. duplicate span warnings negligible.
Karla: ramp to 25% if stable for 10m. keep retries disabled to avoid stress on Auth0.
Ben: ramping to 25% now; monitoring.
Auth0-support: final update: root cause was an internal cache invalidation bug causing unintended rate limits on token refresh endpoints. fix deployed and metrics back to baseline. recommending client-side backoffs and reducing refresh frequency.
Aly: adding technical action items: 1) INFRA-7801: implement centralized token cache/proxy for exporters, 2) INFRA-7802: change default exporter retry strategy to exponential backoff + jitter and cap concurrent retries, 3) add alert for auth-error-rate with vendor correlation.
Karla: customer impact summary: hosted API customers in us-west-1 may have experienced delayed/absent traces during the window (~15:02Z-15:20Z). Dedicated/private deployments unaffected. estimated affected orgs: ~22 orgs with active tracing in region. severity: P2.
Ben: post status update to customers with timeline and mitigation steps. include recommended actions for customers that saw gaps (replay options, check for duplicate spans).
Karla: posted update and emailed affected customers. incident status: mitigated -> monitoring, leaving exporters buffered for 15m to ensure no regression.
ops-bot: Incident RI-2026-201987 marked mitigated (exports buffered; token provider stabilized). oncall: Karla. severity: P2 -> monitoring.
Aly: follow-ups: schedule infra retro week after to prioritize INFRA-7801/7802, add token provider outage playbook, and update our exporter docs about safe retry limits.
Ben: creating the postmortem doc and linking vendor tickets: HB-31022, AUTH-9876.
Karla: handing off oncall to Aly in 20m. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
pagerduty-bot: On-call handoff scheduled: Karla -> Aly at 2019876720.
Ben: leaving thread open for 1h; will close after postmortem draft.
